Alex: Hey team, saw a subtle perf regression on canary this morning: short-context (<=64)  p50 latency up ~12% after the recent kernel-pick tweak. Attaching profiler excerpt and a short trace.

Alex: profiler snapshot (hotspots):
```
wall_time_ms  count  op
---------  -----  -------------------------
45.2       1200   decode_path_dispatch
22.8        900   prefill_kernel_select
14.7       2400   kv_cache_lookup (misses spiked)
6.1         300   pack_small_batches
```

Priya: ugh. do we have a flamegraph or stack collapse? is this only on Ampere nodes? :eyes:

Alex: flamegraph attached in thread (short), repro runs on both Ampere and H100 but much worse on Ampere. The trace shows lots of short requests switching from decode-path->prefill-path and back in the same session (path-churn).

Mateo: path-churn + kv_cache misses = suspicious. If prefill path is grabbing big KVC footprints for prefix caching and then decode path evicts useful entries, you'll thrash. Did autotuner recently change score weighting to prefer lower compute over cache-friendliness?

Alex: yes, autotune made compute-cost weight +10% to favor fused kernels. That likely nudged short ctx to prefill-path picks which prefetch larger KV slabs.

Jo: proposal: add a hysteresis window in bucket->path mapping. require a path confidence delta for N requests before switching. Also track a "path-churn" metric (counter per session) and penalize paths that increase churn.

Priya: agree. can we implement quick guard: if kv_cache_miss_rate increases >3% after a path switch, rollback to previous path for that session for 5s? minimal code change, should catch regression.

Sam: I can run targeted canaries. Repro command: 
```bash
./bench_tool --model redwood-v2 --seq-len 32 --qps 120 --sessions 500 --trace Kv,Path
```
Run that on ampere-standby pool and collect /metrics/path_churn and /metrics/kv_miss_rate.

Mateo: for autotuner change I'd prefer calibrating on architecture-aware profiles: add architecture multiplier so Ampere penalizes prefill-prefetch size more than H100. That avoids one-size-fits-all.

Alex: +1. short-term: Priya's rollback guard. mid-term: hysteresis + arch multipliers. long-term: add path-stability as a score dimension in autotuner (docs + experiment plan).

infra-bot: deploy queued: "deploy/autotuner-v2.3.1" by Sam (canary) -> started at 2329000018

Jo: quick experiment plan: 1) enable rollback guard on canary for 24h; 2) run Sam's bench for 6h; 3) collect path_churn, kv_miss_rate, p50/p95 by seqlen; 4) if p50 delta < 2% and churn drops, promote. I'll draft the PR for hysteresis after canary results.

Priya: assigning tasks: Sam = run benches + collect traces; Jo = PR for hysteresis; Mateo = profile arch multipliers and produce recommended weights; Alex = rollout guard patch + monitor dashboard.

Alex: thanks. I'll post results here when canary finishes. If anyone sees unexpected spike, ping @Alex and attach bench logs. :thumbsup:
